parts:
Hi,
Sorry to bother you guys with my very basic problem. My setup is as follows,

Mac Yosemite, Keyboard: DE
Lavaan 0.5-18


I am trying to run the very first example of the tutorial,

example1 <- data.frame(HolzingerSwineford1939)

First.CFA <-  'visual =˜ x1 + x2 + x3
              textual =˜ x4 + x5 + x6
              speed =˜ x7 + x8 + x9'

fitmodel <- cfa(First.CFA, data=example1)
summary(fitmodel)

In cfa command line I am having this error,

> fitmodel <- cfa(First.CFA, data=example1)
Error in lavParseModelString(model) :
  unknown operator in visual=˜x1+x2+x3

Is there anyone who can help me to solve this problem?

_HM

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: First example in the tutorial: Error in lavParseModelString(model) :    unknown operator
parts:
Your syntax looks correct, so I copied and pasted it directly into an *.R file to try running it.  The "unknown operator" is your tilde ( ˜ ), which is not the tilde that is recognized ( ~ ).  I don't know where you got the wrong kind of tilde (perhaps you copied it from a PDF or HTML file, which had the wrong kind?).  But the right kind of tilde is typically found on the keyboard underneath the ESC key, to the left of the digit "1" (you have to hold SHIFT to type it).

Terry
